carrier.header: group=0, byte1=(dst<<4)|0x01, byte2=fieldA(0), byte3=fieldB(module/vap), total=12+0x10+len, id=2, byte8=0, byte9=dst, tag=0x5A5A
carrier.payload: u32 cookie0 | u32 cookie1 | u16 key=0x0101 | u16 len | alg_cfg_blob[len] | 4 B inherited pad

alg_blob_layout.offset_8: u8 en_need_w4_dev_return (1 -> device answers with g1 id3 config-syn)

expected_response.payload: u32 cookie0 | u32 cookie1 | u16 syn_id=0x0101 | u16 body_len=270 | body[270] | 4 B alloc pad
checks: header byte3 (field B) mirrors the request field B
no firmware exception: exception mask CA 0x40008 stays 0, handshake page stays 0x86807FEF/7/2/0xABCD

commands.name: set_2g_power_param
commands.values_source: per-unit factory cal file (local-only) or zero-value structural probe; vendor defaults are runtime BSS and not statically recoverable

commands.name: set_5g_power_param
commands.values_source: same as 3502 (harmless on a 2.4 GHz-only board)

commands.name: set_xo_ppm_cali_param
commands.destination_on_device: system xo-ppm globals (u32 at value offset 0; 0 -> default 0x4040 path)
commands.values_source: u32 ppm from factory cal file, or 0 (default path)

commands.name: set_rssi_param
commands.values_source: 40-byte block from factory cal file, or zeros (structural probe; lowest blast radius -> recommended first calibration fire)

safety.values_policy: never commit calibration values; zero-value structural frames are generated by tools/proto_seq_frames.py; local per-unit values are passed at bench time
safety.writes: the only device writes are the existing SR node + mailbox id3 announce of the clean driver; never write CECE during boot, never write out[5]=CA 0x400392F0
safety.stop_on: exception mask != 0, handshake page change, H2D announce not consumed, malformed/absent response, any unexpected D2H group/id
